tagline: NPCs can now wear mods, with a more compact creation panel.

entries.headline: NPCs can now wear mods, imported from an MCDF or a Glamourer design and shared with the room, in a more compact creation panel.

sections.title: Modded NPCs
items: Import a modded appearance from an MCDF file or from a design in the Glamourer library.
"Copy my look" detects your mods: if your character wears any, they are sent with the NPC; otherwise nothing changes.
Files go through the relay, only to the room's members, and are published as soon as a room is joined.
Players without Penumbra, or who have not enabled the option, see the NPC's base version.
New option "Accept GMs' modded NPCs", off by default. Penumbra and Glamourer are required for the GM, Penumbra for players.

sections.title: Interface
items: More compact "Create an NPC" card: name and "Copy my look" on one line, one line per import source.
The confirmation message shows at the top of the tab and fades out after 5 seconds.
The "Templates" and "Character sheet" tabs are merged into a single "Sheets" tab: my sheet in play, my sheets, then room rules and templates for the GM.
A single code import field for templates, and sheets are created by picking their template in one click.
Full-page editors with a breadcrumb, an always-visible save bar and collapsible sections; the template editor shows a worked example of the chosen rule.
Deleting a sheet or a template asks for confirmation, and actions are labelled (Load, Edit, Activate, Share).
The "Markers" and "NPCs" tabs are merged into a single "Field" tab: one filterable list, a single "Add" button, and NPC creation on its own page.
The Turns tab gets a single main action ("Next round"), a per-participant action menu and a confirmation before ending the encounter.
Loading a sheet activates its template; activating a template loads the first sheet that uses it (without replacing a sheet already loaded with that template).

sections.title: Fixes
items: Importing a recent Ktisis/Anamnesis .chara file works again (race, tribe, gender and age spelled out, facial features).
Saving the active template now applies its new rules immediately (threshold, die direction, criticals), for the GM and players, without reloading it.
Threshold mode: the 3D die no longer adds the stat to the roll, the target shows as soon as the die lands, and default criticals follow the die direction.
In threshold mode, a stat's value is shown without a "+" (roll tiles, sheets, history): it is a threshold, not a bonus.
